name: What materials are commonly used for exterior wall weatherproofing?

mainEntity.name: What materials are commonly used for exterior wall weatherproofing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for exterior wall weatherproofing include various types of sealants and coatings, such as elastomeric coatings, acrylics, and silicone-based products, which create a barrier against moisture. For brick and stone, water repellents or penetrating sealers are often applied. Flashing, made from metal or flexible membranes, is used around windows, doors, and rooflines to direct water away. Proper house wraps and vapor barriers are also essential beneath siding or stucco to manage moisture within wall assemblies. The choice of material depends on the existing wall type and specific weather challenges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common materials include elastomeric coatings, silicone sealants, water repellents, and flashing. House wraps and vapor barriers are also key components for managing moisture.
